caption: The drawing features six square swatches arranged in two columns and three rows on a plain, light-colored background. The top left swatch is beige with a repeating black floral motif. The top right swatch is yellow with a pattern of small red flowers and black leaves evenly spaced. The middle left swatch is red with a diamond-shaped trellis pattern in black. The middle right swatch has a geometric design with a grid of black-and-white squares, each square containing a brown motif resembling a stylized leaf or flower. The bottom left swatch is brown with a lighter brown wavy background and small red-and-white fruit-like shapes scattered throughout. The bottom right swatch is tan with a recurring black botanical motif, spaced widely apart.
title: Quilt Patches
